sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Opens the app in doodle mode without showing the plan selection screen. Log in from the home screen to use a plan.
Removes the monthly drawing time limit. Unlocks saving and exporting in doodle mode and full-length timelapse export with an optional logo.
